coverage.scope: Visible entries of ~/Developer and selected Ragnarok subprojects. Aliases mapped; hidden paths, private records, raw logs, archives and dependency/build trees excluded from content review.

server_archive.scope: All 18 top-level Seagate entries listed; four source-oriented archive groups traversed to depth five (34 directories); member headers inspected in 31 selected consolidated project packages. Data exports, secret material, system images and transcript contents were excluded.
server_archive.finding: The Seagate is mounted read-only (ro, norecovery). Its consolidation snapshot contains historical project packages, including versions related by name to current work and packages not present in the current Developer inventory. The catalog separates these from current source. Similar names do not establish byte-for-byte equivalence.
server_archive.contents_read: Archive member metadata only; no project was executed and no payload was extracted to disk.

main_project.quote: ALEXUS emerges when complexity has compressed into simplicity. When the system knows itself well enough that it no longer needs to explain itself.
main_project.continuation: The name carries the intention forward until the system is ready to read it back.
main_project.origin_quote: Ragnarok isn't the end. It's the beginning. Point A -> everything in-between -> Point C. Live your own life. Don't let it live you.
theory: Everything starts from one point. Life branches outward in complexity. Then it recedes back into the main trunk.
The branch is not the destination. The trunk is. Complexity is not the goal — it is the process. The goal is what remains when the process completes.
The loopback is built in. What branches out returns. What returns is refined. What is refined becomes the new origin point.
main_project.attribution: CLR — Rgnrk · Origin and Branch Theory
